SELECT
    category_id,
    NULLIF(TRIM(category_name), '') AS category_name,
    NULLIF(TRIM(description), '') AS description,
    picture,
    _airbyte_extracted_at AS loaded_at

FROM "warehouse"."bronze"."categories"

WHERE category_id IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(category_name), '') IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    employee_id,
    TRIM(territory_id) AS territory_id,
    _airbyte_extracted_at AS loaded_at
FROM "warehouse"."bronze"."employee_territories"
WHERE
    employee_id IS NOT NULL
    AND territory_id IS NOT NULL

WITH dates AS (
    SELECT
        GENERATE_SERIES(
            DATE '1996-01-01',
            DATE '1998-12-31',
            INTERVAL '1 day'
        ) AS date_day
)

SELECT
    date_day AS date_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date_day) AS year,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM date_day) AS quarter,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date_day) AS month,
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(date_day, 'Month')) AS month_name,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM date_day) AS day,
    TRIM(TO_CHAR(date_day, 'Day')) AS day_name

FROM dates

SELECT
    TRIM(customer_id)   AS customer_id,
    TRIM(company_name)  AS company_name,
    TRIM(contact_name)  AS contact_name,
    TRIM(contact_title) AS contact_title,
    TRIM(address)       AS address,
    TRIM(city)          AS city,
    TRIM(region)        AS region,
    TRIM(postal_code)   AS postal_code,
    TRIM(country)       AS country,
    TRIM(phone)         AS phone,
    TRIM(fax)           AS fax,
    _airbyte_extracted_at AS loaded_at

FROM "warehouse"."bronze"."customers"

WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(customer_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  AND NULLIF(TRIM(company_name), '') IS NOT NULL

SELECT
    order_id,
    product_id,
    unit_price,
    quantity,
    discount,

    _airbyte_extracted_at AS loaded_at

FROM "warehouse"."bronze"."order_details"

WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
  AND product_id IS NOT NULL
  AND quantity > 0
  AND unit_price >= 0
  AND discount BETWEEN 0 AND 1
